3. 🤝 M&A

SIAA acquires Canopy Specialty Insurance

SIAA has acquired Canopy Specialty Insurance, a specialty commercial property and casualty MGA operating in the US and UK. The acquisition adds specialty underwriting and product development capabilities alongside SIAA’s agency alliance, retail business Sequel Insurance Agencies and wholesale operation Xchange. Canopy develops and underwrites niche commercial insurance products for small and midsized businesses, including contractors’ liability, excess casualty and legal indemnity programs.

  1. El dato clave: The acquisition adds specialty underwriting and product development capabilities alongside SIAA’s agency alliance, retail business Sequel Insurance Agencies and wholesale operation Xchange.

4. 💰 Inversión

Blitzy launches review tool for AI-generated code

Blitzy , an autonomous software development platform backed by Erie Strategic Ventures, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures, and New York Life Ventures, has launched PR Review, a feature designed to help engineering teams understand and review AI-generated code faster. The launch addresses a growing bottleneck as AI agents generate code faster than engineers can review it. Blitzy’s process allows engineers to approve the proposed scope and approach before code generation, with automated tests, builds, benchmarks, and static analysis incorporated into development.

  1. El contexto: The launch addresses a growing bottleneck as AI agents generate code faster than engineers can review it.

  3. ¿Qué vigilar? El capital invertido anticipa las áreas donde los incumbentes afrontarán mayor presión competitiva en los próximos 12-24 meses.

La industria respalda el impulso a la digitalización, pero pide que las nuevas normas preserven la neutralidad tecnológica y mantengan incentivos para seguir expandiendo la aceptación de pagos electrónicos. México emprenderá reformas regulatorias para ampliar la aceptación de pagos digitales, con el objetivo de reducir costos para los comercios, extender el uso de medios electrónicos en trámites y servicios públicos y fortalecer la interoperabilidad entre bancos, fintechs y procesadores. Los cambios normativos avanzan en dos frentes: un anteproyecto regulatorio que plantea ajustes a los costos de procesamiento y a las cuotas de intercambio en operaciones con tarjeta, y la iniciativa de Ley de Economía Digital , que busca ampliar la aceptación de pagos electrónicos en los tres niveles de gobierno y facilitar una mayor adopción de códigos QR.

Open-source artificial intelligence is making it easier for hackers to hide malicious code on blockchains, opening a new front in a crypto industry already grappling with rising cybercrime. In the attacks documented by the report, hackers use a blockchain to leave instructions for that software, such as the location of the server that controls it, a technique known as a “blockchain dead drop.” This can make an attack harder to stop because information recorded on a blockchain cannot be easily removed. Blockchains are typically not involved in the initial infection of a machine, which often happens through conventional means such as supply-chain attacks or malicious downloads, Eric Jardine, head of research at Chainalysis, said in response to questions over email.
